questions.def: When topicalising, use 'it + be-verb + subject' for emphasis.
questions.question: That book, ___ I really enjoyed.

questions.def: Topicalisation needs 'it + be-verb' to highlight the topic.
questions.question: This cake, ___ my sister made.

questions.def: Use simple past tense to describe a completed action.
questions.question: That pizza, I ___ all of it.

questions.def: 'That's where' emphasizes the location after fronting.
questions.question: To the park, ___ we go every Sunday.

questions.def: 'That's how I feel' emphasises the feeling (adjective).
questions.question: Happy, ___ when I am with my friends.

questions.def: Use the base form 'like' in simple present for general truths.
questions.question: That song, I really ___ it.

questions.def: Use 'that's how I feel' to emphasize the feeling/state.
questions.question: Tired, ___ after a long day at work.

questions.def: 'That's what' highlights the purpose of the item.
questions.question: My bike, ___ I ride to work.

questions.def: Use simple past 'bought' to describe a completed action.
questions.question: Those flowers, I ___ for my mother.

questions.def: 'That's what it is' emphasizes being late.
questions.question: Late, ___ always when I wake up.

questions.def: 'That's what' is used to emphasize the need for the coffee.
questions.question: This coffee, ___ I need right now.

questions.def: Use simple past 'made' for finished action.
questions.question: This soup, my dad ___ it.

questions.def: 'That's where' emphasizes Italy is the desired destination.
questions.question: To Italy, ___ I want to go one day.

questions.def: 'That's how I feel' emphasizes the feeling of annoyance.
questions.question: Annoyed, ___ when people are late.

questions.def: Use past simple 'saw' to describe a finished action.
questions.question: That movie, I ___ it last week.

questions.def: 'It's the one' emphasises the job as the preferred choice.
questions.question: That job, ___ I really want it.

questions.def: 'That's what' emphasizes the use of the phone.
questions.question: My phone, ___ I use it for music.

questions.def: Use the present simple form 'need' here.
questions.question: That holiday, I ___ one soon.

questions.def: 'That's where' adds emphasis to the location (beach).
questions.question: To the beach, ___ we are going tomorrow.

questions.def: 'That's how I feel' emphasizes the feeling of excitement.
questions.question: Excited, ___ before my birthday.

questions.def: Use 'wants' with third person singular (she).
questions.question: That dress, she really ___ it.

questions.def: 'That's how I am' emphasizes the state of being sleepy.
questions.question: Sleepy, ___ in the mornings.

questions.def: 'That's what' highlights the use/purpose of the computer.
questions.question: My computer, ___ I use it for work.

questions.def: Fronting 'that book' needs a subject and verb in the main clause.
questions.question: That book, I ___ it last year.

questions.def: After fronting, the main clause needs a simple verb.
questions.question: My keys, I can't ___ them anywhere!

questions.def: Fronted noun phrase needs a simple past tense verb in the main clause.
questions.question: That cake, I ___ it all myself!

questions.def: Fronted prepositional phrase requires a main clause verb.
questions.question: To the park, we ___ yesterday.

questions.def: After fronting, a simple present tense verb is required.
questions.question: Those shoes, I really ___ them!

questions.def: Fronting needs a simple past tense in the main clause.
questions.question: This soup, my mom ___ it.

questions.def: Fronted noun phrase requires 'will' for future tense.
questions.question: My homework, I ___ finish it tonight.
